csr_crime_spree_brief:
Crime Spree Roguelike is an endless series of randomly selected heists, executed in succession. With each heist you complete, your Rank and Reward will increase. With each Rank enemies grow stronger, but so do you with infinitely stacking Items that can increase your health, damage, or even give some unique abilities.

Completing heists and securing loot will grant you a new currency, Gage Tokens. Good old buddy Gage will offer his wares for them. Be sure to check the Black Market once in a while.

The rest you will figure out on your own. Good luck!

csr_logbook_dog_tags_notes:
He always came in first. Before everyone else on shift, before everyone else on scene. We joked that he lived there.

I don't know why I'm writing this. Command already filed their report. Everything's in order - date, circumstances, rank. All by the book.

What the report doesn't mention is that he brought coffee for the whole department every Friday. That he remembered the names of every colleague's kids. That when a shift turned quiet he'd pull out a worn paperback and read - always something about history, never said what exactly.

The tags were never found. They say someone took them off the body.

What the hell did they want with his tags. A trophy? A souvenir? I hope they're keeping busy while we're looking for them.

Bastards... I'd kill you myself.
csr_logbook_duct_tape_notes:
DUSK TAPE™ - for any situation.
Leaky pipe? DUSK TAPE™.
Need to strap a flashlight to anything? DUSK TAPE™.
Door won't close? DUSK TAPE™.
Drill gave out mid-job? DUSK TAPE™.
Hostages being too loud? DUSK TAPE™.
DUSK TAPE™ - holds everything. Always. No questions asked.
Available at hardware stores nationwide.
csr_logbook_escape_plan_notes:
March 3rd. Started today. Under the bed, in the corner - there's a tile that's been cracked for ages, nobody notices. Smuggled the shovel in pieces. Spent a long time figuring out how - turned out easier than I thought. The guards here are dumb.

March 19th. Almost a meter deep. Hands are blistered. I hide the dirt in my mattress, then flush it down the toilet.
Slow, but it's working.

April 2nd. Three meters. By my calculations - same distance again and I'll be past the outer wall. I counted the steps when they took us out for exercise.

April 14th. Five meters. Soon.

April 21st. Dug through the night. The soil felt softer. Just a little more.

April 22nd. Came up in cell №108.

Garcia was asleep there.

He didn't even seem surprised. Just looked at me and said - "wrong way."

I know, Garcia. I know.
csr_logbook_aloe_leaf_notes:
- ...How many times do I have to say it. Don't eat aloe leaves when you're sick.
- But the TV said-
- 'The TV said'! What, if they told you jumping off a roof cures cancer, you'd do that too?!
- ...
- Wh-? No. No-no-no! I will tie you to the bed. I mean it.
csr_logbook_tactical_pen_notes:
OFFICE OF THE MEDICAL EXAMINER
Autopsy Report - Case PD-2014-0631

Deceased: John Doe (unidentified).
Cause of death: a single penetrating wound at the base of the skull.

The wound channel is unusually deep and remarkably clean - no tearing at the edges. The depth and precision are inconsistent with a standard writing instrument.

Recovered from the body: one (1) ballpoint pen. Office-grade. No distinguishing marks.

I have catalogued stab wounds, gunshots and worse for nineteen years. I cannot explain how this was done with a pen. A freaking pen...

(Off the record: I would rather not see another one of these.)
csr_logbook_worn_bandaid_notes:
"You'll be fine, buddy. I've got you." - said the medic with a warm smile as he bandaged my gunshot wound.
"Hey, doc. Why do you keep reusing band-aids? Isn't that against hygiene rules?" - I winced.
"Why? Do you have any idea how many band-aids it takes to patch someone up? You think one? Two? It takes dozens. Sometimes hundreds."
I looked around and only now noticed the shelves were packed with band-aids. "Looks like I'm leaving here as a band-aid mummy," I thought to myself, and just kept enduring.
csr_logbook_lockes_beret_notes:
- "The Major's got fourteen of them. I counted."
- "Fourteen berets?"
- "Yeah. All identical. Lined up in his quarters."
- "Damn..."
- "Oh, and he also got one dress shirt that's still in dry-cleaning bag. Receipt said 2009..."
- "..."
- "Reyes saw him at an airport once. Off-duty."
- "And?"
- "Full kit. Beret and all. Said he looked completely normal about it."
- *Footsteps in the corridor.*
- "Morning, sir." / "Morning, sir."
- "Aye, friends."
- *Footsteps recede.*
- "Fifteen. I miscounted."
csr_logbook_cup_of_joe_notes:
- Total stolen: 1 artifact, 3 assault rifles, a set of samurai armor, a server... and a cup of Joe.
- Sorry, a cup of Joe?
- A cup of Joe.
- ...
- So where's Joe, exactly?
- Not funny.
- No, seriously. Where's Joe?
- Oh, that Joe. He's right over there. Crying about his favorite mug being stolen.
csr_logbook_rebar_notes:
INCIDENT REPORT
Case No. 2014-7732-CR
Date: October 27, 2014
Filed by: Detective S. Morris, Violent Crimes Division

At approximately 2:00 PM, a directed explosion was recorded in the underground transport corridor of the Federal Courthouse, District of Columbia. The device was planted in the outer concrete wall. The nature of the damage indicates professional placement - destruction strictly contained to the target area. No civilian casualties. Three escort officers were killed on the scene; two others hospitalized in critical condition.

At the time of the explosion, the convoy was transferring inmate James "Jim" Hoxworth, known as "Hoxton". Hoxworth has since disappeared from the scene.

A fragment of construction rebar, approximately 24 centimeters in length, was recovered in the corridor bearing biological trace evidence. DNA analysis confirmed it belongs to Hoxworth. The nature of contamination suggests a penetrating wound to the lower extremity. The rebar was removed on-site - bandaging materials were also found nearby.

.......................................................................................................................................
csr_logbook_half_a_glass_notes:
His hands reached for the magnifying glass. A malicious grin looked right through me, consuming what little humanity I had left. "Interesting..." - the demonic voice echoed toward me. So this is how it ends? My worthless life finally coming to a close? All because of my own stupid decisions. No-no-no. I can't... I can't give up now... I won't-!

A shot rings out.
csr_logbook_evidence_rounds_notes:

From: Detective R. Hughes
Re: Missing evidence

During a routine inspection, a shortage was found in box №14 (section D):
- Non-standard ammunition, $rounds round(s) (case PD-2014-11847)

No signs of forced entry. Last access - Sergeant P. Tucker, February 12th.
Tucker retired February 14th.

Please initiate an internal investigation.
csr_logbook_falcogini_keys_notes:
LOST
Lost a set of Falcogini F40 keys near Fourth Avenue. Red keychain, chip key with logo. Please return - the car is the only thing I have left of my father.
Reward: $500
Tel: (555) 013-0124
csr_logbook_wolfs_toolbox_notes:
Dear representatives of Eisen Brechmann Tools,
I am writing to inform you that your products are absolute garbage.
The drill I purchased in 2013 (model EB-7700X) has broken down SEVENTEEN TIMES over the past eight months.
Every time at the worst possible moment. Every. Single. Time.
I demand either a full refund or a replacement with something that is actually capable of functioning properly.
With no regards,
W.
csr_logbook_pink_slip_notes:
You should've seen his face when he came to me! "Robbers in clown masks threatened me!" Ha-ha-ha! What an idiot! Serves him right for getting fired.
Inaudible muttering.
Right... Him? Bob Bubblehead or something? What a stupid last name... No-no, I'm not talking to you!
Inaudible muttering.
Of course. I want this partnership just as much as you do, Mr. Garnet.
csr_logbook_the_edge_notes:
"I wish this prick would just shoot himself." - the last thought spinning in my head. It felt like this nightmare would never end. "If I'm going to die, at least let it be with a clear conscience and rotten lungs."

Click.

My turn now...
csr_logbook_overkill_rush_notes: I'm alive...? How? Right... This isn't just a game anymore... It feels like punishment for my sins. What am I saying? This is a nightmare. There's no way out. What are my options... Not many... Adrenaline. Yeah, that'll help. I'll take his... Beer. Yeah, I could really go for a beer right now... No! What is wrong with me? What the hell do I want with beer?! Huh? A phone... Yeah, I'll call the police. And... Or... I don't know! God help me!
csr_logbook_bonnie_chip_notes: Bonnie isn't someone you can easily catch off guard. Poker and gambling in general isn't a simple game where you either win everything or lose it all before you can blink. At least that's what Bonnie thinks. In her words, poker is a "slow psychological duel." Sure, luck plays its part. But you always have to keep your cool, arm yourself with patience, never let your emotions show... Or just shoot your opponents. Works 100% of the time. (Cases where they shoot back are not counted.)
csr_logbook_plush_shark_notes:
This is Gura. She's always with me - on a job, after a job, everywhere. My irreplaceable friend and partner.
Rust tried to throw her out once, but I quickly reminded him that I'm not someone to mess with. He hasn't bothered me since. Smart of him.
Gura has pulled me out of some serious shit that I can't even begin to explain. Some kind of magic or whatever. (Not that I actually believe in that stuff.)
csr_logbook_jiro_last_wish_notes:
Jiro wrote this letter when he still lived in Japan. His son was the most precious thing he had left. He only wished to be reunited with him, even if just through a letter.

The envelope is worn and slightly crumpled. No stamp, no proper address - just "USA".

Why he never sent it - nobody knows.
csr_logbook_dearest_possession_notes: The crew doesn't know exactly where Dallas got his obsession with medic bags. But one thing they know for sure - Dallas genuinely loves them. Real love isn't shown through "I love you", gifts, or a partner's attention. It's shown through nothing other than: "AAAAAAA!!! I NEED A MEDIC BAG!"
csr_logbook_viklund_vinyl_notes:
Everyone connected to Crime.net knows who Bain is, but nobody knows who he actually is. Once me and the crew got into an argument about what kind of music our mysterious hacker might listen to. Someone suggested Alesso, but I said that's too mainstream for a guy like him. Then someone said classical, but that didn't fit either. "Maybe something modern? Like dubstep or drum and bass?" I got tired of the argument and just decided to ask him directly. "Curious about my taste? Heh, alright, but don't make a face. I don't have a favorite genre or artist, but I can say that I've taken a bit of a liking to the work of someone called Viklund."

Who the hell is Viklund?
csr_logbook_dozer_guide_notes:
How to become a "wall". A beginner's guide.

1. Infiltrate a military warehouse and steal one sapper uniform.
2. Learn to shout loud and intimidating phrases. For example: "Out of the way. Bulldozer coming through!" or "You are nothing to me!"
3. Forget about running. Walls don't run. Move slowly, confidently, and with dignity - as if you have nowhere to be.
4. To become a "wall", you must act like a "wall". Bullets and explosives should not concern you. Dodging is for the weak.
5. Upon spotting clowns, stay calm and move forward. They will shoot, they will scream. But don't give up. Run straight at them. They will fear you. (Well, in theory at least.)
csr_logbook_glass_pistol_notes:
PROTOTYPE TEST REPORT
Designation: Prototype GG-1 ("Glass")
Date: June 14, 2011

The sample demonstrates outstanding lethality, significantly exceeding standard police issue weaponry.

Issue: The weapon's structure proved far too fragile and literally fell apart after firing. 6 testers were hospitalized. Two died on the scene.

Recommendation: Discontinue production. Transfer to storage category "G".
csr_logbook_equalizer_notes:
You all keep sending me messages like "how do I make my music sound like yours?", "why does it sound like that", "what headphones do I need" and all that stuff. Look, you don't need any expensive headphones. That's all nonsense. You just need an Equalizer! It's simple. You buy this thing, plug it into whatever you listen to music on, plug your headphones into it, and start tweaking the knobs until it sounds "cool". That's it! But to make it easier, here are my settings:
Bass: -12 dB (why do these even exist?)
Mids: -6 dB (boring too)
Highs: +15 dB (now we're talking!)
Phone rings.
One sec guys.
My producer called and said I'm not allowed to advertise products on stream. You know what? Screw him! I'm the one making music here, and they're just cashing in on my work.

csr_logbook_crooked_badge_notes:
March 14th, 2014
Hey diary... What a stupid way to start, but whatever. So, lately I've been feeling off. My colleagues have been giving me looks. The therapist says journaling will help me let go of my "inner ailments". Heh... Funny... He doesn't even know what I did. Nobody knows but me. What if someone reads this someday? Nah, doubt it. I'll burn it then. Alright, it's late. Going to sleep.

March 20th, 2014
Don't feel like doing anything. Why am I even writing this right now? -----------

March 21st, 2014
Yesterday was a really rough day, and I don't know why I even wrote any of that. I feel like people are starting to dislike me. I understand them, can't blame them, but... Never mind.

March 24th, 2014
It's always so hard to figure out what to write. Well, I lost my badge. I don't really know what's next for me, to be honest. Maybe I'll join "them"... Maybe I'll start robbing places myself. No, that's a terrible idea. I need to buy more sleeping pills.

The following pages are impossible to read as they are half-burned.
csr_logbook_dead_mans_trigger_notes:
LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT
Written: November 3rd. Afghanistan.

If you are reading this - I didn't make it back.

The house and everything in it - to Sara. The car - to my brother, he's had his eye on it for a while. The money in the account - to my mother. She can spend it however she likes.

To the guys in the unit - separately. I'm sorry. I didn't want you to get caught in it. You knew what you were getting into, but it was still my idea. Forgive me.

To Major Heller - nothing. He knows why.
The device is on me. Let them take it. Along with me.

(Former) Private First Class D. Ward
csr_logbook_familiar_friend_notes: It's 11th of August, 2020. Field Report #57. Subject: unidentified gelatinous organism, designated UGO-1 for documentation purposes. Behavior appears non-aggressive. Further observation requ- it just looked at me. Oh-oh... I think I am spotted. I need to run. How to turn off this thing...?! *leaves noises* *panic breathing* Is it still recording? I think it is. I got away. The subject appears to 'hop' around like some kind of bunny or rabbit. It's orange with yellow tint. It has some sort of horns..? I didn't quite catch what they were, but... *away from microphone* What the hell? Oh god... *into the mic again* The subject just duplicated itself. It became smaller, but now there's two of them. I... I've never seen anything like this. This is so... Beautiful. Maybe they are not bad. I will try to reason with it. *more noises* Hello, buddy. *strange alien noises* Whoa. Subject can produce sounds, but they are unlike anything I've heard from animals. Can I touch you? Ew... You're so sticky. But, at the same time, kinda cute? *petting* *strange loud alien noise* Ow! It just spiked me! It appears that its gelatinous body can reshape into spikes. I... Uh... *recording stops*
